brief: The US Treasury escalates sanctions against Iran, while Trump announces new tariffs on Canadian goods, intensifying trade tensions. In research, papers explore AI explanations, visualization design, and the impact of framing on data donation.
news_summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announces a major sanctions offensive against Iran, while Trump threatens new tariffs on Canadian cars, trucks, and steel. Other news includes a deadly US strike in the Pacific, an SEC probe into an AI hedge fund, and a Gatwick car park fire.
papers_summary: Recent papers cover topics like adaptive explanations for programming errors, reflections on visualization research with older adults, and affective framing in data donation. Also featured are studies on AI documentation and a concept inventory for visualization design.
